権.name: Authority
権.meaning: A <radical>tree</radical>, a <radical>gun</radical> and a <radical>turkey</radical>. The turkey with a gun in the tallest tree has the <kanji>authority</kanji>.
権.reading: Ken, けん, tries to argue with it. 権利 is a right; 政権 political power.

済.name: Finish
済.meaning: <radical>Water</radical> that's <radical>equal</radical> on both sides. The flood is settled: <kanji>finish</kanji>ed.
済.reading: Cut the last reeds with a scythe, さい. 経済 is the economy (ざい); 済む to be finished.

認.name: Recognize
認.meaning: <radical>Say</radical> something and <radical>endure</radical> the silence until they <kanji>recognize</kanji> you're right.
認.reading: It's a ninja, にん, who finally admits it. 確認 is confirmation; 認める to recognise.

論.name: Argument
論.meaning: <radical>Say</radical> things, and a <radical>person</radical> over a <radical>volume</radical> of books. Someone reads up to win the <kanji>argument</kanji>.
論.reading: They argue on the lawn, ろん. 議論 is a debate; 理論 a theory.

疑.name: Doubt
疑.meaning: A <radical>spoon</radical>, an <radical>arrow</radical>, <radical>mama</radical> and a <radical>coat rack</radical>. Mama finds a spoon and an arrow on the coat rack and has her <kanji>doubt</kanji>s.
疑.reading: A goose goes "ぎ?" too. 疑う is to doubt; 疑問 a question.

供.name: Offer
供.meaning: A <radical>person</radical> <radical>together</radical> with others. They <kanji>offer</kanji> things up together.
供.reading: They offer Kyoto sweets, きょう. 子供 is child (ども); 提供 offer.

割.name: Divide
割.meaning: <radical>Harm</radical> and a <radical>knife</radical>. The knife does harm: it <kanji>divide</kanji>s things.
割.reading: わる: the plate breaks in two and you say "Whoa, rude!" 割る is to divide; 割引 a discount. かつ in compounds.

難.name: Difficult
難.meaning: <radical>Grass</radical>, a <radical>mouth</radical>, a <radical>husband</radical> and a <radical>turkey</radical>. Getting all that into one kanji is <kanji>difficult</kanji>.
難.reading: Take a break with some naan, なん. 難しい is difficult (むずかしい).

優.name: Gentle
優.meaning: A <radical>person</radical> with <radical>grief</radical>. People who've known grief are <kanji>gentle</kanji> with others.
優.reading: They play the ukulele, ゆう, softly. 優しい is kind; 女優 an actress.

収.name: Income
収.meaning: A <radical>stick</radical> and a <radical>stool</radical>. Stand on the stool and use a stick to reach your <kanji>income</kanji> on the top shelf.
収.reading: Keep it in a shoe, しゅう. 収入 is income.

宅.name: Home
宅.meaning: <radical>Seven</radical> under a <radical>roof</radical> with something <radical>slide</radical>ing in. Seven people at <kanji>home</kanji>.
宅.reading: Pin up a picture with a tack, たく. お宅 is your home; 帰宅 going home.

警.name: Warn
警.meaning: <radical>Respect</radical> over <radical>say</radical>. Say it respectfully: you're giving a <kanji>warn</kanji>ing.
警.reading: Write the warning on a cake, けい. 警察 is police; 警告 a warning.

訪.name: Visit
訪.meaning: <radical>Say</radical> which <radical>direction</radical>. You ask the way to <kanji>visit</kanji> someone.
訪.reading: Bring a hose, ほう, as a gift. 訪問 is a visit; 訪ねる to visit.

若.name: Young
若.reading: わかい: so young you say "wacky!" 若い is young. In compounds it's じゃく.

段.name: Step
段.meaning: A pile of layers and a club. Hack <kanji>step</kanji>s into the cliff.
段.reading: A dancer, だん, runs up them. 階段 is stairs; 値段 a price.

呼.name: Call
呼.meaning: A <radical>mouth</radical> with breath <radical>slide</radical>ing out on a <radical>barb</radical>. You <kanji>call</kanji> out.
呼.reading: よぶ: you call "yo, boo!" 呼ぶ is to call. In compounds, こ: 呼吸, breathing.

値.name: Value
値.meaning: A <radical>person</radical> who can <radical>fix</radical> it. They know its <kanji>value</kanji>.
値.reading: A cheetah, ち, sets the price. 値段 is a price (ね); 価値 value.

処.name: Deal With
処.meaning: <radical>Winter</radical> by the <radical>table</radical>. Sit down and <kanji>deal with</kanji> the winter bills.
処.reading: Shovel them away, <reading>しょ</reading>. <ja>処理</ja> is processing.

否.name: Deny
否.meaning: <radical>Not</radical> over a <radical>mouth</radical>. The mouth says no: <kanji>deny</kanji>.
否.reading: Step on their heel, ひ. 否定 is denial.

存.name: Exist
存.meaning: A <radical>person</radical> and a <radical>child</radical> under a roof. The family keeps on: they <kanji>exist</kanji>.
存.reading: A sonar ping, そん, proves it. 存在 is existence; ご存知 knowing (ぞん).

座.name: Sit
座.meaning: Two <radical>person</radical>s on the <radical>dirt</radical> under a <radical>canopy</radical>. They <kanji>sit</kanji> down in the shade.
座.reading: One has a zapper, ざ. 座る is to sit; 口座 a bank account.

除.name: Remove
除.meaning: A <radical>building</radical> with a <radical>surplus</radical>. <kanji>Remove</kanji> the extra stuff.
除.reading: Cousin Joe, じょ, hauls it out. 掃除 is cleaning (じ); 除く to remove.

降.name: Descend
降.meaning: A <radical>building</radical> with <radical>winter</radical> feet going down the <radical>steps</radical>. <kanji>Descend</kanji>.
降.reading: A koala, こう, comes down too. 降りる is to get off; 降る to fall (rain).

危.name: Dangerous
危.meaning: <radical>Misfortune</radical> with someone <radical>slide</radical>ing off the top. It's <kanji>dangerous</kanji> up there.
危.reading: Lock the gate with a key, き. 危ない is dangerous; 危険 danger.

背.name: Back
背.meaning: <radical>North</radical> over the <radical>moon</radical>. Two people sitting back to back: your <kanji>back</kanji>.
背.reading: They give a high five, はい, over their shoulders. 背中 is back (せ).

勤.name: Work
勤.meaning: <radical>Grass</radical>, <radical>three</radical> and <radical>power</radical>. You cut the grass three times with all your power: hard <kanji>work</kanji>.
勤.reading: For the king, きん. 通勤 is commuting; 勤める to work for.

困.name: Troubled
困.meaning: A <radical>tree</radical> inside an <radical>enclosure</radical>. It can't grow. It's <kanji>troubled</kanji>.
困.reading: Put an ice cream cone, こん, on it. 困る is to be troubled.

刻.name: Engrave
刻.meaning: A <radical>top hat</radical> over a <radical>person</radical>, and a <radical>knife</radical>. Carve their hat with the knife: <kanji>engrave</kanji> it.
刻.reading: Carve a cork, こく. 時刻 is the time; 深刻 serious.

欲.name: Desire
欲.meaning: A <radical>valley</radical> and a <radical>yawn</radical>. A mouth wide as a valley: that's <kanji>desire</kanji>.
欲.reading: It wants the egg yolk, よく. 欲しい is wanting; 意欲 motivation.

痛.name: Pain
痛.meaning: <radical>Sick</radical>, and <radical>mama</radical> needs to <radical>use</radical> a bandage. You're in <kanji>pain</kanji>.
痛.reading: Hit by a tsunami, つう. 痛い is painful; 頭痛 a headache.

探.name: Search
探.meaning: <radical>Fingers</radical> under a <radical>lid</radical> on <radical>legs</radical> by a <radical>tree</radical>. You <kanji>search</kanji> everywhere.
探.reading: Inside a tank, たん. 探す is to search; 探偵 a detective.

閉.name: Close
閉.meaning: A <radical>gate</radical> with <radical>talent</radical> inside. Someone clever figured out how to <kanji>close</kanji> it.
閉.reading: Block it with a hay bale, へい. 閉める is to close.

暮.name: Live
暮.meaning: <radical>Grass</radical>, the <radical>sun</radical> and something <radical>big</radical>. The big sun sinks into the grass. You go home to <kanji>live</kanji> your evening.
暮.reading: くらす: the class ends at sunset. 暮らす is to live; 暮れる to get dark.

吸.name: Suck
吸.meaning: A <radical>mouth</radical> that can <radical>reach</radical> anything. It <kanji>suck</kanji>s it in.
吸.reading: It sucks up a cue stick, きゅう. 吸う is to suck; 呼吸 breathing.

忘.name: Forget
忘.meaning: <radical>Deceased</radical> over your <radical>heart</radical>. The memory died in your heart: you <kanji>forget</kanji>.
忘.reading: You forget your bow and arrow, ぼう. 忘れる is to forget.

誤.name: Mistake
誤.meaning: <radical>Say</radical> what you <radical>give</radical>. You said the wrong thing: a <kanji>mistake</kanji>.
誤.reading: Blame the goat, ご. 誤解 is a misunderstanding.

洗.name: Wash
洗.meaning: <radical>Water</radical> that goes on <radical>ahead</radical>. Rinse it first: <kanji>wash</kanji>.
洗.reading: You wash a cent, せん. 洗う is to wash; 洗濯 laundry.

窓.name: Window
窓.meaning: A <radical>hole</radical> with something <radical>private</radical> and a <radical>heart</radical> beneath it. A hole you peep into someone's heart through: a <kanji>window</kanji>.
窓.reading: A soda can, そう, flies through it. 窓 on its own is まど; 窓口 a service counter.

腹.name: Belly
腹.meaning: <radical>Moon</radical> (flesh), a <radical>gun</radical>, the <radical>sun</radical> and <radical>winter</radical>. Your <kanji>belly</kanji> rumbles all winter.
腹.reading: Hang your belt on a hook, ふく. お腹 is stomach (なか); 腹 is はら.

頂.name: Summit
頂.meaning: A <radical>street</radical> and a <radical>head</radical>. The street goes to the top of the head: the <kanji>summit</kanji>.
頂.reading: Plant chocolate, ちょう, on top. 頂上 is a summit; 頂く to receive (humble).

晩.name: Evening
晩.meaning: The <radical>sun</radical> with an <radical>excuse</radical> to leave. It's <kanji>evening</kanji>.
晩.reading: Pack the van, ばん. 今晩 is tonight; 晩ご飯 dinner.

歳.name: Age
歳.meaning: <radical>Stop</radical> at the <radical>cliff</radical>, a <radical>small</radical> step and a <radical>halberd</radical>. Every year you carve a notch: your <kanji>age</kanji>.
歳.reading: Carve it with a scythe, さい. 二十歳 is 20 years old (はたち).

与.name: Give
与.meaning: A hook dangling off a line. You <kanji>give</kanji> it to someone.
与.reading: Give them a yo-yo, よ. 与える is to give.

違.name: Differ
違.meaning: <radical>Leather</radical> on a <radical>scooter</radical>. The biker jacket makes you look <kanji>different</kanji>.
違.reading: You ride like an eel, い. 違う is to differ; 間違い a mistake.

渡.name: Cross
渡.meaning: <radical>Water</radical> and a <radical>degree</radical>. Measure the angle and <kanji>cross</kanji> the river.
渡.reading: わたる: "water row", you row across the water. 渡る is to cross; 渡す to hand over.

突.name: Stab
突.meaning: Something <radical>big</radical> bursting out of a <radical>hole</radical>. It <kanji>stab</kanji>s straight up.
突.reading: A toddler, とつ, jumps out. 突然 is suddenly.

捕.name: Catch
捕.reading: Catch it in a hose, ほ. 捕まえる is to catch (つか); 逮捕 arrest.

迎.name: Welcome
迎.meaning: A <radical>stamp</radical> on a <radical>scooter</radical>. Ride out with your seal to <kanji>welcome</kanji> the guests.
迎.reading: At the gate, げい. 迎える is to welcome; 歓迎 welcome.

彼.name: He
彼.meaning: <radical>Going</radical> along with <radical>skin</radical> showing. There <kanji>he</kanji> goes, shirtless again.
彼.reading: On his heels, ひ. 彼 is he (かれ); 彼女 she, girlfriend.

舞.name: Dance
舞.meaning: The <radical>dance</radical> feet under a roof with things <radical>slide</radical>ing about on the <radical>ground</radical>. <kanji>Dance</kanji>!
舞.reading: In boots, ぶ. 舞台 is a stage; お見舞い a hospital visit.

込.name: Crowded
込.meaning: <radical>Enter</radical> on a <radical>scooter</radical>. Everyone rides in: it's <kanji>crowded</kanji>.
込.reading: こむ: packed as a comb's teeth. 込む is to be crowded. This kanji was made in Japan and has no on'yomi.

頼.name: Rely
頼.meaning: A <radical>bundle</radical> and a <radical>head</radical>. You <kanji>rely</kanji> on the head of the family to carry the bundle.
頼.reading: たのむ: "tan, no moo!" you ask the cow nicely. 頼む is to ask. In compounds, らい: 信頼 trust.

途.name: Route
途.meaning: <radical>Surplus</radical> on a <radical>scooter</radical>. Deliver the extra along the <kanji>route</kanji>.
途.reading: Stub your toe, と, halfway. 途中 is on the way.

抜.name: Pull Out
抜.meaning: <radical>Fingers</radical> and a <radical>friend</radical>. Your friend helps you <kanji>pull out</kanji> the splinter.
抜.reading: ぬく: it comes out with a "nook" sound. 抜く is to pull out. In compounds, ばつ.

婚.name: Marriage
婚.meaning: A <radical>woman</radical>, a <radical>clan</radical> and the <radical>sun</radical>. Two clans join on a sunny day: a <kanji>marriage</kanji>.
婚.reading: An ice cream cone, こん, for the cake. 結婚 is marriage.

浮.name: Float
浮.meaning: <radical>Water</radical>, a <radical>claw</radical> and a <radical>child</radical>. A claw holds the child up so it can <kanji>float</kanji>.
浮.reading: うく: it floats like an ukulele. 浮く is to float. In compounds, ふ.

押.name: Push
押.reading: おす: push the oars. 押す is to push. In compounds, おう.

到.name: Arrival
到.meaning: <radical>Arrive</radical> and a <radical>knife</radical>. Cut the ribbon on <kanji>arrival</kanji>.
到.reading: A toad, とう, gets there first. 到着 is arrival.

倒.name: Fall Over
倒.meaning: A <radical>person</radical> at their <radical>arrival</radical>. They're so tired they <kanji>fall over</kanji>.
倒.reading: Onto a toad, とう. 倒れる is to fall over; 面倒 a bother.

払.name: Pay
払.meaning: <radical>Fingers</radical> reaching for something <radical>private</radical>. Your wallet: time to <kanji>pay</kanji>.
払.reading: はらう: you pay and say "hurrah, woo!" 払う is to pay.

遅.name: Late
遅.meaning: A <radical>flag</radical> and a <radical>sheep</radical> on a <radical>scooter</radical>. The sheep is slow and you're <kanji>late</kanji>.
遅.reading: おそい: "oh, so late!" 遅い is late or slow; 遅れる to be late.

抱.name: Hug
抱.reading: だく: hug a duck. 抱く is to hug; 抱える to hold (かか).

恐.name: Fear
恐.meaning: <radical>Craft</radical>, something <radical>ordinary</radical> and a <radical>heart</radical>. An ordinary tool turns scary and your heart jumps: <kanji>fear</kanji>.
恐.reading: A haunted Kyoto temple, きょう. 恐い is scary; 恐怖 terror.

戻.name: Return
戻.meaning: A <radical>door</radical> and something <radical>big</radical>. Something big comes back through the door: it <kanji>return</kanji>s.
戻.reading: もどる: "mo' doors!" 戻る is to return.

越.name: Cross Over
越.meaning: <radical>Run</radical> past a <radical>cliff</radical> with a <radical>halberd</radical>. You <kanji>cross over</kanji> the border.
越.reading: こす: cost of crossing. 越す is to cross; 引っ越す to move house.

互.name: Mutual
互.meaning: <radical>Two</radical> lines with a <radical>pig head</radical> between. They face <kanji>each other</kanji>.
互.reading: Two goats, ご, butt heads. お互い is each other.

逃.name: Escape
逃.reading: にげる: "knee, get moving!" 逃げる is to run away. In compounds, とう.

緒.name: Together
緒.meaning: <radical>Thread</radical> and <radical>someone</radical>. Tie someone to you with thread and you're <kanji>together</kanji>.
緒.reading: Stitch it with a shovel, しょ. 一緒 is together.

掛.name: Hang
掛.meaning: <radical>Fingers</radical>, <radical>dirt</radical> and a <radical>toe</radical>. <kanji>Hang</kanji> your muddy boots up with your fingers.
掛.reading: かける: hang it with a cake on top. 掛ける is to hang (and to phone).

寝.name: Sleep
寝.meaning: A <radical>bed</radical>, a <radical>broom</radical>, a <radical>lid</radical> and a <radical>stool</radical> under a <radical>roof</radical>. The bedroom. <kanji>Sleep</kanji>.
寝.reading: ねる: sleep in your nest. 寝る is to sleep. In compounds, しん.

盗.name: Steal
盗.meaning: <radical>Next</radical> over a <radical>plate</radical>. When nobody's looking, you <kanji>steal</kanji> the next plate.
盗.reading: A toad, とう, runs off with it. 盗む is to steal.

御.name: Honorable
御.meaning: <radical>Going</radical> and <radical>wholesale</radical>. The <kanji>honorable</kanji> merchant goes to trade. Used as the polite お/ご prefix.
御.reading: A goat, ご, pulls his cart. 御飯 is a meal (usually ご飯).

吹.name: Blow
吹.meaning: A <radical>mouth</radical> and a <radical>yawn</radical>. Open wide and <kanji>blow</kanji>.
吹.reading: ふく: blow, and the air goes foo-coo. 吹く is to blow. In compounds, すい.

娘.name: Daughter
娘.reading: むすめ: "moose, meh." She's not impressed by the moose. 娘 is daughter.

怒.name: Angry
怒.meaning: A <radical>guy</radical> over a <radical>heart</radical>. That guy makes your heart <kanji>angry</kanji>.
怒.reading: おこる: "oh, Cora!" She's angry again. 怒る is to get angry. In compounds, ど.

杯.name: Cup
杯.meaning: A <radical>tree</radical> that is <radical>not</radical> a tree anymore: it's been carved into a <kanji>cup</kanji>.
杯.reading: Raise it for a high five, はい. 一杯 is a cupful, or full.

疲.name: Tired
疲.reading: You can't stand on your heels, ひ. 疲れる is to get tired.

皆.name: Everyone
皆.meaning: <radical>Compare</radical> over <radical>white</radical>. Compare everyone in the room: <kanji>everyone</kanji> is wearing white.
皆.reading: Everyone flies a kite, かい. 皆さん is everyone (みな).

煙.name: Smoke
煙.meaning: <radical>Fire</radical> in the <radical>west</radical> over the <radical>dirt</radical>. <kanji>Smoke</kanji> rising from a western campfire.
煙.reading: Smoke signals cost a yen, えん. 禁煙 is no smoking; 煙 smoke (けむり).

眠.name: Sleep
眠.meaning: An <radical>eye</radical> and the <radical>people</radical>. At night all the people close their eyes to <kanji>sleep</kanji>.
眠.reading: They chew a mint, みん, first. 眠い is sleepy; 睡眠 sleep.

怖.name: Scary
怖.reading: It has a hoof, ふ. 怖い is scary (こわい); 恐怖 terror.

髪.name: Hair
髪.meaning: <radical>Long hair</radical> and a <radical>friend</radical>. Your friend braids your <kanji>hair</kanji>.
髪.reading: Put on a hat, はつ. 髪 is hair (かみ); 散髪 a haircut.

忙.name: Busy
忙.meaning: <radical>Feelings</radical> that are <radical>deceased</radical>. You're so <kanji>busy</kanji> your heart has died.
忙.reading: You have no time to fire your bow and arrow, ぼう. 忙しい is busy.

靴.name: Shoes
靴.meaning: <radical>Leather</radical> that goes through a <radical>change</radical>. Leather becomes <kanji>shoes</kanji>.
靴.reading: Leave them in your car, か. 靴 is shoes (くつ); 靴下 socks.

恥.name: Shame
恥.meaning: An <radical>ear</radical> and a <radical>heart</radical>. When you hear what they say about you, your heart burns with <kanji>shame</kanji>.
恥.reading: はじ: "hodgepodge" of shame. 恥ずかしい is embarrassing.

偶.name: Chance
偶.meaning: A <radical>person</radical> and a weird creature: the <radical>sun</radical>, a <radical>helmet</radical> and a <radical>rice paddy</radical>. You meet it by <kanji>chance</kanji>.
偶.reading: It's made of goo, ぐう. 偶然 is by chance.

偉.name: Great
偉.reading: They wrestle an eel, い. 偉い is great.

猫.name: Cat
猫.meaning: An <radical>animal</radical> in the <radical>seedling</radical>s. It's a <kanji>cat</kanji> hiding in the garden.
猫.reading: ねこ: it wraps round your neck, oh! 猫 is cat.
